name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

details.overview: PM-KISAN provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families through direct transfers, subject to scheme exclusions.
benefits: The portal describes ₹6,000 per year in three instalments for eligible families.
eligibility_guidance: Landholding farmer family criteria and government exclusions apply. Confirm the applicable record and exclusions through the official portal.
procedure: Use the official Farmers Corner for new farmer registration and eKYC. Check the beneficiary status after registration.

rules.explanation: The scheme applies to eligible landholding farmer families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

details.overview: PMFBY offers crop insurance for farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including eligible tenant farmers and sharecroppers.
benefits: Insurance protection is tied to the notified crop, area and applicable season.
eligibility_guidance: Verify whether the crop and area are notified and whether you can show insurable interest in the crop.
procedure: Check the applicable notification and use the official crop insurance portal or an authorized enrolment channel.

documents.name: Proof of land possession, lease or other state-accepted farming rights
Sowing certificate or self-declaration of intent to sow
Aadhaar or enrolment ID if seeding or eKYC is incomplete

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
department: Department of Financial Services

sources.title: State Bank of India Kisan Credit Card
Reserve Bank of India KCC guidelines

details.overview: KCC is a bank credit facility that supports crop cultivation and related agricultural needs. Lending decisions and documentation are handled by the participating bank.
benefits: Provides access to revolving farm credit subject to the lender’s sanctioned limit.
eligibility_guidance: Participating lenders publish criteria for owner-cultivators and other qualifying borrower groups.
procedure: Review the participating bank’s KCC instructions and approach the branch or its online channel.

name: PM-KUSUM Scheme
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

details.overview: PM-KUSUM supports decentralized solar generation, standalone solar agricultural pumps and solarisation of existing agricultural pumps through distinct components.
benefits: Supports agricultural solar power and pumping through component-specific arrangements.
eligibility_guidance: Eligible applicants depend on the component and state implementation agency. Check its current notice.
procedure: Use the national portal to identify your state implementing agency and the relevant component.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
department: Ministry of Jal Shakti

details.overview: PMKSY is an umbrella irrigation and water-management programme that aims to expand access to irrigation and improve water-use efficiency.
benefits: Its components support irrigation infrastructure and improved water management.
eligibility_guidance: Access is component- and location-specific. The central programme listing does not establish individual eligibility.
procedure: Identify the relevant component and check the state implementing department’s process.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

sources.title: Digital Platform for Farm Mechanization and Technology

details.overview: SMAM supports access to farm machinery and custom hiring, including in areas and among groups with low mechanization coverage.
benefits: Assistance varies by approved machinery, component, applicant category and state allocation.
eligibility_guidance: Verify the component and state target before purchasing equipment.
procedure: Check availability and the assistance calculator on the official Digital Platform for Farm Mechanization and Technology.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

details.overview: PKVY promotes cluster-based organic farming, including organic inputs, participatory certification and marketing support.
benefits: Eligible clusters may receive support for organic conversion and market development under programme guidelines.
eligibility_guidance: Participation operates through approved clusters and state programme implementation.
procedure: Contact the state agriculture department to check cluster participation.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

sources.title: NIC Soil Health Card Portal project

details.overview: The Soil Health Card initiative uses soil testing to provide nutrient information and fertilizer recommendations for agricultural land.
benefits: A card can help farmers make better-informed nutrient and fertilizer decisions.
procedure: Ask the local agriculture office about soil sampling and card access.

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

details.overview: This programme helps form and develop Farmer Producer Organisations through designated implementing agencies and cluster-based business organisations.
benefits: Guidelines provide for organisation development, handholding and specified forms of financial support.
eligibility_guidance: Support is structured around eligible producer organisations and implementing agencies.
procedure: Consult the designated implementing agency or local cluster-based business organisation about participation.

name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

sources.title: PIB National Beekeeping and Honey Mission brief

details.overview: The National Beekeeping and Honey Mission supports scientific beekeeping and the honey value chain, including post-harvest infrastructure and research.
benefits: Support is organised through mission components and eligible proposals.
procedure: Check the implementing agency’s current call for the relevant mission component.

name: Krishi Bhagya Scheme
department: Karnataka Department of Agriculture

details.overview: Krishi Bhagya focuses on rainwater harvesting and water management for rainfed agriculture in Karnataka.
benefits: Programme descriptions include farm ponds and related measures to conserve and use rainwater.
eligibility_guidance: Check the district and current programme components before planning work.
procedure: Ask the local agriculture department whether the programme is available in your area.

name: Ganga Kalyana Scheme
department: Karnataka development corporations

details.overview: Ganga Kalyana provides groundwater irrigation support through borewells or tube wells for eligible individual or group beneficiaries.
benefits: Eligible projects may receive irrigation infrastructure support.
eligibility_guidance: Eligibility depends on the administering development corporation and its current applicant criteria.
procedure: Identify the development corporation applicable to your category and check its current notification.

name: Pashu Bhagya Scheme
department: Karnataka Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services

details.overview: Pashu Bhagya is a Karnataka animal husbandry programme described by Gadag District for establishing livestock units and supporting their maintenance.
benefits: The district description includes bank-linked subsidy and short-term maintenance credit.
eligibility_guidance: Verify current assistance and farmer-category requirements with the department and participating bank.
procedure: Ask the district animal husbandry office about the relevant livestock activity and application window.

name: Farm Mechanization Subsidy – Karnataka
department: Karnataka Department of Agriculture

details.overview: Karnataka’s district agriculture department lists farm mechanization assistance among its programmes.
eligibility_guidance: Confirm eligible machinery, applicant category and the current district allocation.
procedure: Check the Karnataka district agriculture office for the application route before purchasing equipment.

name: Micro Irrigation Subsidy – Karnataka
department: Karnataka horticulture and agriculture departments

details.overview: Karnataka district horticulture programme information includes micro-irrigation support. Eligible systems and assistance depend on local implementation.
benefits: Participation may help eligible cultivators adopt efficient irrigation systems, subject to current rules.
procedure: Ask the district horticulture office to confirm the eligible crop, system and current application process.

name: SSP Post-Matric Scholarship
department: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal participating departments

sources.title: Karnataka technical education SSP eligibility and document guidance

details.overview: Karnataka’s State Scholarship Portal provides a common application route for post-matric scholarships administered by different departments.
eligibility_guidance: Requirements vary by sponsoring department and award. Check the SSP notice for your course and category.
procedure: Open SSP, choose the relevant department scheme, and follow its document e-attestation instructions where applicable.
details.previous_eligibility: The published SSP guidance listed separate document and eligibility conditions for different sponsoring departments.

documents.name: Income certificate when required by the department
Caste certificate when required by the department
Previous-year marks card for applicable awards

dependencies.condition: Obtain or renew the income certificate if the selected SSP award requires income documentation.

name: Vidyasiri Scholarship
department: Karnataka Backward Classes Welfare Department

details.overview: Vidyasiri provides food and accommodation assistance for qualifying Karnataka students under the applicable departmental programme.
eligibility_guidance: Check the sponsoring department’s notice for study level, residential arrangements and other conditions.
procedure: Review the department notice and use SSP where the notice directs applicants there.

documents.name: Income certificate where the current Vidyasiri notice requires it
Caste or category certificate for applicable applicants

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
department: Karnataka Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood

sources.title: Karnataka Fiscal Policy Institute Yuva Nidhi scheme summary

details.overview: Yuva Nidhi is a Karnataka unemployment assistance programme for eligible graduates and diploma holders.
benefits: The published assessment describes monthly support of ₹3,000 for graduates and ₹1,500 for diploma holders, for up to two years or until employment.
eligibility_guidance: Cohort, education, residence and unemployment conditions depend on the current notification.
procedure: Find the current Yuva Nidhi notice and designated registration channel through Seva Sindhu.
details.previous_eligibility: The published first-phase assessment covers the 2022–23 cohort and describes at least 180 days of unemployment and Karnataka domicile. See the current notice for later cohorts.

sources.title: Karnataka Directorate of Minorities NSP 2022–23 application timeline

details.overview: The National Scholarship Portal brings together scholarships from multiple authorities and provides application and tracking services.
benefits: The portal lets students discover and manage applications. Awards and benefits vary by scholarship.
eligibility_guidance: Open a specific scholarship to see its own eligibility and document conditions. The portal itself has no universal eligibility test.
procedure: Review scheme guidelines on the portal and complete the current registration process before applying to a specific scholarship.
details.previous_application_period: In 2022–23 the Directorate of Minorities listed 31 October 2022 as the deadline for the Post-Matric and Merit-cum-Means entries in its NSP notice.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Karnataka Department of Women and Child Development

sources.title: Karnataka Fiscal Policy Institute scheme assessment

details.overview: Gruha Lakshmi is a Karnataka household financial assistance programme administered through state channels, with published criteria tied to the head of the household.
eligibility_guidance: The state assessment describes the ration-card head-of-family requirement and tax-related exclusions. Confirm the current instructions.
procedure: Check the current Gruha Lakshmi service or status instructions through Seva Sindhu.

rules.explanation: Published Gruha Lakshmi criteria require a woman listed as the head of the household on an applicable ration card.

dependencies.condition: Review the household ration card because the published Gruha Lakshmi criteria use ration-card records.

name: Udyogini Scheme
department: Karnataka State Women Development Corporation

sources.title: Bengaluru Rural district Women Development Corporation programme information

details.overview: Udyogini supports qualifying women pursuing income-generating activities through a bank-linked programme administered by the Karnataka State Women Development Corporation.
eligibility_guidance: Confirm current age, income, activity and applicant category criteria in the administering office’s notice.
procedure: Contact the district corporation office about applications and participating banks.

name: Stree Shakti Self-Help Group Scheme
department: Karnataka Department of Women and Child Development

sources.title: Kodagu district Women and Child Development programmes

details.overview: Stree Shakti supports women’s self-help groups in Karnataka as a platform for collective savings, economic activity and support.
eligibility_guidance: Check local self-help group formation and participation requirements.
procedure: Contact the district Women and Child Development office or local programme office.

name: Bhagyalakshmi Scheme
department: Karnataka Department of Women and Child Development

details.overview: The Bhagyalakshmi scheme described by Gadag District supports eligible girls in below-poverty-line households in Karnataka.
eligibility_guidance: Confirm the current cohort, household requirements and enrolment process with the department before relying on the historical district listing.
procedure: Check the current state or district women and child development office notice.
details.previous_eligibility: The district scheme information describes eligibility for girls from BPL households.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
department: Ministry of Rural Development

sources.title: Government of Nagaland NSAP programme and eligibility

details.overview: IGNOAPS is the old-age pension component of the National Social Assistance Programme.
eligibility_guidance: The published programme criteria cover people aged 60 or older in qualifying below-poverty-line households. State top-ups and procedures can differ.
procedure: Contact the relevant local authority or state social welfare department for the application process.

name: Widow Pension Scheme
department: Ministry of Rural Development

sources.title: Government of Nagaland NSAP programme and eligibility

details.overview: This entry refers to the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme under NSAP. States may have additional widow pension programmes.
eligibility_guidance: The published source describes eligible widows from qualifying below-poverty-line households aged 40 or older. Check state implementation.
procedure: Ask the local or state social welfare authority how to apply.

rules.explanation: The cited NSAP programme summary lists a minimum age of 40.

name: Disability Pension Scheme
department: Ministry of Rural Development

sources.title: Government of Nagaland NSAP programme and eligibility

details.overview: This entry refers to the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme under NSAP, with separate state-specific programmes possible.
eligibility_guidance: The programme applies to eligible people from below-poverty-line households who meet the prescribed age and severe or multiple disability criteria.
procedure: Confirm requirements and apply through the applicable local or state social welfare authority.

name: Ration Card
department: Karnataka Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs

sources.title: National Food Security portal Karnataka resources

details.overview: Karnataka ration-card services cover household records used by the public distribution system. The national NFSA Karnataka page points citizens to state resources.
eligibility_guidance: Eligibility and supporting documents depend on the household category and requested transaction.
procedure: Use the state food department channel listed on the official Karnataka NFSA page.

name: Driving Licence
department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

sources.title: Delhi Transport Department permanent licence guidance

details.overview: Driving licences are issued by state licensing authorities under the national motor vehicles framework. Select the relevant state and vehicle class for the application.
eligibility_guidance: The relevant learner’s licence and applicable class, age and testing conditions must be checked.
procedure: Choose your state on the Sarathi portal and follow the licensing authority’s instructions for a permanent driving licence.

documents.name: Valid learner’s licence for the relevant class

name: Income Certificate
department: Karnataka Revenue Department

details.overview: Karnataka’s Revenue Department issues an income certificate following an application and verification by the competent officials.
eligibility_guidance: Check the district service instructions for accepted supporting evidence and any case-specific documents.
procedure: Apply online or visit the designated office. Retain the acknowledgement and follow the application status and certificate instructions.

documents.name: Caste certificate for the category where required

name: Caste & Income Certificate
department: Karnataka Revenue Department

details.overview: This Karnataka Revenue Department service provides a combined caste and income certificate for applicable purposes. It is distinct from a stand-alone caste certificate.
eligibility_guidance: The certificate form and accepting authority depend on the applicant category and purpose.
procedure: Follow the district’s instructions or visit the relevant Tehsil or Tahsildar office.
